name: ZZF burnToHolder pays BNB at a live spot quote
summary: ZZF.burnToHolder prices the ZongZi a user burns with uniswapRouter.getAmountsOut against WBNB and has the ZongZi token pay that many BNB from its reward pool into ZZF, from which receiveRewards pays the burner. After flash-loan buys pumped the WBNB/ZongZi pair, the attacker burned ZongZi at the inflated spot quote and withdrew nearly all of the pool's BNB in two transactions.

loss.notes: BNB depletion of the ZongZi reward pool across both attacker transactions. The attacker's flash-loan buys left about 656 more WBNB in the WBNB/ZongZi pair, which is not netted; the reported ~$223k is the attacker's net profit after that pump. A 4.32 BNB claim by 0xb89b232238b1bad9f144443960f600ea51cb0418 later in the block is not counted.

ageReset.description: setMainToken pointed ZZF's _burnToken at the ZongZi token, whose BNB pool it prices and pays from.

sources.note: Loss. debug_traceTransaction(prestateTracer, diffMode) gives the BNB balance of ZongZi token 0xbb652d0f1ebbc2c16632076b1592d45db61a7a68 as 1296.955539645 -> 173.34066896614004 in source-1 (block 37272888, index 20) and 173.34066896614004 -> 11.475832347380283 in source-4 (index 22, sent by 0xe5c326b7595bae6894ad15c7bc1e7eb74cbdb2a6 through the same attack contract 0x0bd0d9ba4f52db225b265c3cffa7bc4a418d22a9). The pool had been topped up 1296.549539645 BNB at index 10 of the same block (0x4caf0a2200ceb31f43cbaf769d1493e37d6bee9edee60ee2dad80708a641d677) by protocol contract 0xbba75fb6e7da22ddcab49f0e9498620a33654e64, created by the ZongZi deployer, when a fresh EOA triggered it. In source-1 ZongZi pays 1296.9612543565418 BNB to ZZF, forwarded to the attacker, while receiving 472.29990370461917 BNB from its own tax swaps. Etherscan V2 internal transactions show only three ZongZi-to-ZZF payouts since deployment, all in block 37272888.

Root cause, anchor and age. Verified ZZF source (Etherscan V2 getsourcecode; SHA-256 of SourceCode a5388b32ac9f5fe6a0b189ba6ccce2630dce297314c14f72f7f4a61a871abbf3): burnToHolder sets deserved = uniswapRouter.getAmountsOut(amount, [_burnToken, WETH]) and calls _burnToken.zongziToholder(sender, amount, deserved), which sends that many BNB from the ZongZi pool to ZZF; receiveRewards transfers the credited amount to the caller. Source-1 first swaps flash-loaned WBNB into the WBNB/ZongZi pair 0xd695c08a4c3b9fc646457ad6b0dc0a3b8f1219fe, then burns, then sells. Earliest exercise: the payouts noted in source-5 are the only ZongZi-to-ZZF transfers, and source-1 is the first. Age: eth_getCode of ZZF is empty at block 35945160 and keccak256 of its runtime is the recorded hash at blocks 35945161 and 37272887; source-2 is a top-level creation by deployer 0x95bf53764944fe19629f0e38f0edb02762cfff7c. ZZF predates the ZongZi token (created block 35947416); its storage slot 31 (_burnToken) holds 0x1daf898c0b491bb9b4fde487e6384c3b3213ee63 until owner setMainToken in source-3 (block 35947489) sets the ZongZi token, unchanged through block 37272887. ZongZi's setzongziHolder(ZZF) at block 35947477 precedes it. The owner's later transaction to ZongZi (excludedFromFees, block 36349771) does not bear on the payout path.
